commonPrompt:
Create clean wordless fitness-science teaching illustrations in the style of Ranking of Kings. Only recognizable male Bojji and Despa may appear: Bojji is one short boy with black hair, a tiny golden three-point crown, cobalt-blue tunic, white pants and black boots; never a tall adult. Despa is one adult male teacher with swept-back blond short hair, two small blond moustache tufts, rust-red long coat, white fur collar, beige pants and dark boots. Use fine dark-gray outlines, flat colors, and very light soft shading; no photorealism, 3D, thick paint, advertising lighting, other characters, logos, watermarks, Chinese text, English text, numbers, labels, readable screens, arrows, chart axes, blue circles or unexplained markers. Output a true transparent PNG: every unpainted pixel alpha 0; never render a white or gray checkerboard, floor, room, paper background, loose paper sheets, border, sticker edge, shadow, or halo. A small unmarked rigid evidence card is allowed as a prop. White pants and fur collar remain opaque white. Keep every body and prop fully inside a six-percent safe margin.

Additional course-specific guardrails: 固定波吉与德斯帕，二维教学画法，深灰细轮廓和平涂；每张最多各出现一位波吉和一位德斯帕，均为一个安全姿态。每张为真实透明PNG；无健身房背景、地板、边框、影子、棋盘格、水印或品牌。 不生成文字、数字、计时器、时钟、箭头、图表、节奏符号、重量标识、Logo或无关装饰。 自由重量、长凳和哑铃必须结构正确、完整、无悬空配重；动作只用轻负荷或自重，避免高风险或失控姿态。
